_comment: Robot layout for v4_s1_v4_hl (COOHAVIOR's S1-V4-HL), ported to Merom_1_int.
Five boxes, five rooms, V4's full five-set configuration -- poses are
audit_index.json's own, robot_set_count 5, and are identical to HH's to the
last decimal (same stations M5, M3, M2, M1, M4; the FANUC checkpoint arms
dropped as elsewhere). One team per station, each starting in the room its
own box is in.
Cargo is dice-iswudu at 0.008 kg: tasks.modified.json makes HL a *light*
task, like LL, so per its execution contract the drone may lift and carry
it and a package needs only a push_car. That is what separates HL from HH,
whose 20 g notebooks the drone may not touch.
THE BDDL GOAL HOLDS AT t=0. V4's HL goals are ontop(box_i, floor_target_i)
with the target floor inroom the same room the box starts in -- its targets
are positions on a floor, ours is a room-level predicate over one floor
object per room, so start and goal are the same object. That is accepted
on purpose (user, 2026-09-12): COOHAVIOR's real structure is the ordered
package sequence in tasks.modified.json, to be enforced by a supervision
layer later; the BDDL goal is only the final state. Until that layer
exists, check_goal is the sole authority over `terminated` and an episode
of this activity ends at env_step 0.
Scales are the ones v4_s1_v4_ll was verified with, not V4's own (the
staging USD says jackal 0.5, ridgeback 1.0, Crazyflie 0.6 (now 2.0, see below)). Unresolved.
Dice and Crazyflie are at scale 2.0 -- twice native -- by decision (user,
2026-09-12), and every later port keeps that: a 1.8 cm die and a 12 cm drone
were too small to see or to reason about at room scale. The drone's 2.0
replaces the 0.6 above; the dice's 2.0 is set in the sampler whitelist and
baked into the cached instance, so a re-sample is needed to change it.
4 robot(s) relocated off V4's staged pose (see _relocated_from): V4 staged them inside
furniture_sink_czyfhq_0 / breakfast_table_skczfi_0. The canonical per-set-count
This file keeps V4's per-station spawn (with the four stuck poses moved to the
nearest open point). The shared-spawn variant -- everyone in living_room_0 --
is coop2/team_layouts/s1/sets_5.json; sets_1 is the three-robot equivalent for ll/lh.
